notablePrerequisites: Wild Growth attached to Golgari Rot Farm.
description:
Activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Wild Growth and Vorinclex's first ability trigger, adding {B/G}{G}.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Deserted Temple's ability, with the copy targeting Golgari Rot Farm.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and Golgari Rot Farm.
Repeat.
